data.one_liner: Read and write Android Storage Access Framework (SAF) documents.
data.what_it_does: Allows Flutter applications to read and write Android SAF DocumentFiles using byte-based APIs, file streams, or custom file streams with skip capabilities. It also supports copying between SAF documents and local files.
use_when: You need to read or write files via the Android Storage Access Framework (SAF).
You need to handle large files using streams on Android.
You need to copy files between SAF documents and local storage.
avoid_when: You are building for iOS, macOS, Windows, Linux, or Web (Android-only plugin).
You only need standard local file paths without SAF requirements.
strengths: Supports both byte-based operations and streaming for large files.
Provides custom file stream options to skip bytes natively and reduce memory usage.
